description: Source code for media remoting stream provider and media stream classes, handling RPC communication, stream initialization, buffer management, and data pipe setup within Chromium's media remoting component.

classes.name: StreamProvider
classes.description: Main class managing media remoting streams, handling RPC communication, stream creation, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream
classes.description: Represents individual media streams, manages RPC messaging, buffer reading, configuration, and data flow.

methods.name: StreamProvider::CreateOnMainThread
methods.description: Creates a MediaStream instance on the main thread.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters RPC callbacks.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::Initialize
methods.description: Starts stream initialization by sending RPC message.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::InitializeDataPipe
methods.description: Sets up data pipe for decoder buffers.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::FlushUntil
methods.description: Flushes buffers up to a specified count.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::OnReceivedRpc
methods.description: Dispatches incoming RPC messages to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::OnInitializeCallback
methods.description: Processes RPC callback for stream initialization.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::CompleteInitialize
methods.description: Completes initialization once RPC callback and data pipe are ready.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::OnReadUntilCallback
methods.description: Handles RPC callback for read-until responses.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::UpdateAudioConfig
methods.description: Updates audio decoder configuration based on RPC message.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::UpdateVideoConfig
methods.description: Updates video decoder configuration based on RPC message.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::SendReadUntil
methods.description: Sends RPC message to request more frames.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::Read
methods.description: Reads next buffer, waits if necessary.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::CompleteRead
methods.description: Completes a read request with status and buffer.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::AppendBuffer
methods.description: Appends received buffer to internal queue.

methods.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream::OnError
methods.description: Handles error conditions by sending RPC error message.
